title: 第一卷 第3章 偶遇第一卷 第4章 危机
lines: 半个时辰后，林风眠来到红鸾峰的山脚下。
几个衣着暴露的女弟子在山道前嬉戏打闹，满园春色。
见林风眠走来，几女纷纷看了过来，目光勾人至极。
“林师弟又来了？”
林风眠微微颔首，笑道：“是啊，陈师姐叫我过来一趟！”
“行了，进去吧！”
几个女弟子对他很熟悉，也不检查，摆了摆手就让他进去了。
相比起检查林风眠，她们更希望让他调查。
林风眠应了一声，正打算进去的时候，一道红色遁光从远处飞来。
几个女弟子见状，神色惊慌，飞快回到岗位上，昂首挺胸，站立如松。
林风眠虽然不明所以，但还是退到一旁，低头肃立。
很快那红光落地，一个三十出头的美妇人风情万种地走来。
她身材丰腴，肤如凝脂，慷慨又大方，衣领开叉极低，傲人的峰峦呼之欲出。
迈步之间，腰臀扭动，开叉的裙摆飞起，浑圆的玉腿一展无遗，可谓风情万种，摇曳生姿。
此情此景，林风眠却是不敢多看一眼。
在玉仙宗想要活得久，管好自己的眼睛和嘴巴很重要。
几个女弟子弯腰行礼道：“赵师伯！”
那赵师伯嗯了一声，轻笑道：“你们这些小妮子，值守期间都给我认真点。”
“你们这样嬉皮笑脸的，我看到没关系，被宗主看到了，少不了责罚你们。”
那几个女弟子连忙道：“是，师伯！”
赵师伯往山道走去，随意瞥了低眉垂首的林风眠一眼，突然脚步一顿。
“你……抬起头来！”
林风眠愣了一下，缓缓抬起头来，忐忑地看着眼前的赵师伯。
“长老？”
这赵师伯长得很好看，而且慷慨又大方，入目一片雪白，让他不知道该看哪里。
与之对视好像不礼貌，低头又不行。
林风眠也只能从心，目光微垂，随波逐流，凝视深渊。
赵凝脂看着林风眠，眼神变了又变，像是看到了什么匪夷所思的东西。
“你……叫什么名字？”
“回长老，弟子林风眠！”
“林风眠？”
赵凝脂皱了皱眉头，又问道：“你是何方人士？”
“东荒赵国人士！”
林风眠忐忑万分地回答，大气都不敢喘一下。
“东荒赵国？”
赵凝脂似乎有些意外，询问道：“你是何人带进门的？”
林风眠想了想，轻声道：“是谢玉燕，谢长老！”
“谢玉燕？”
赵凝脂柳眉微皱，细细打量林风眠，欲言又止。
content_en:
Half an hour later, Lin Fengmian arrived at the foot of Hongluan Peak.
Several scantily clad female disciples were playing and playing in front of the mountain path, and the garden was full of spring scenery.
Seeing Lin Fengmian approaching, the women looked over one after another, their eyes extremely seductive.
"Junior Brother Lin is here again?"
Lin Fengmian nodded slightly and said with a smile: "Yes, Senior Sister Chen asked me to come over!"
"Okay, let's go in!"
Several female disciples were very familiar with him, so they waved their hands and let him in without checking.
Rather than checking Lin Fengmian, they wanted him to investigate.
Lin Fengmian responded, and when he was about to go in, a red light flew from a distance.
When several female disciples saw this, they looked panicked and quickly returned to their posts, with their heads held high and their chests held high, standing as tall as a pine tree.
Although Lin Fengmian didn't understand why, he still stepped aside and stood in silence with his head lowered.
Soon the red light fell to the ground, and a beautiful woman in her early thirties walked over in a charming manner.
She has a plump figure, skin as smooth as cream, generous and generous, her collar is slit very low, and her proud peaks are ready to be exposed.
As she took a step, her waist and hips twisted, her slit skirt flew up, and her round legs were on full display, making her very charming and swaying.
Lin Fengmian did not dare to take another look at this situation.
If you want to live a long life in the Jade Immortal Sect, it is important to take care of your eyes and mouth.
Several female disciples bent down and saluted: "Master Zhao!"
Uncle Zhao hummed, chuckled and said, "You little ladies, please be more serious while on duty."
"It doesn't matter if I see you smiling playfully like this. If the sect leader sees it, you will have to be punished."
The female disciples quickly said: "Yes, Master!"
Master Zhao walked towards the mountain road, casually glanced at Lin Fengmian, who had his eyebrows lowered and his head lowered, and suddenly stopped in his tracks.
"You...raise your head!"
Lin Fengmian was stunned for a moment, then slowly raised his head and looked at Uncle Zhao in front of him anxiously.
"Elder?"
Uncle Zhao was very good-looking, generous and generous. His eyes were so white that he didn't know where to look.
It seems impolite to look at him, and it would be inappropriate to lower his head.
Lin Fengmian could only follow his heart, his eyes slightly lowered, drifting with the tide, staring into the abyss.
Zhao Ningzhi looked at Lin Fengmian, her eyes changing again and again, as if she had seen something incredible.
"What...is your name?"
"Back to the elder, disciple Lin Fengmian!"
"Lin Fengmian?"
Zhao Ningzhi frowned and asked, "Who are you from?"
"People from the Zhao Kingdom in the Eastern Wasteland!"
Lin Fengmian answered with great anxiety, not even daring to take a breath.
"Eastern Wasteland Zhao Kingdom?"
Zhao Ningzhi seemed a little surprised and asked, "Who brought you in?"
Lin Fengmian thought for a while and said softly: "It's Xie Yuyan, Elder Xie!"
"Xie Yuyan?"
Zhao Ningzhi frowned slightly and looked at Lin Fengmian carefully, but stopped talking.
